description: This file defines a function `formatGeneratedModule` that formats a source code string using an external formatter tool (`oxfmt`). It manages temporary files and directories, determines whether to use a locally installed formatter or a fallback command (`pnpm`), and handles potential errors during formatting.

methods.name: formatGeneratedModule
methods.description: Formats a given source code string using an external formatter, handling file creation, command execution, and cleanup mitigating platform-specific differences.
